flags.water-sewer: Whether this parcel has water and sewer service is currently unknown and was not scored, so you should check with PWSA directly [utilities.water_sewer].
flags.adu: Under a proposed rule change that is not yet law, up to 2 accessory dwelling units (small extra homes on the same lot) could be allowed by right on this R2-H zoned parcel, but this bill is only being considered and has not passed [zoning.district, reform.status].
flags.parking-minimum: The same proposed, not-yet-law bill would remove the requirement to build a minimum number of off-street parking spaces, which could free up land and money for more housing, but this is not current law [reform.status].
flags.affordable-housing-bonus: This proposed bill, which is not law yet, would also offer an optional Affordable Housing Bonus for this parcel since it is outside the Inclusionary Housing Overlay area [overlay.iz, reform.status].
flags.hazard-undermined: The entire parcel sits within a mapped undermined area, meaning past underground mining may affect the land, so a mine subsidence or geotechnical review is recommended [hazard.undermined].
flags.gap-financing: This parcel is in an area with low median assessed land value, so gap financing (extra funding beyond a typical loan) may likely be needed; this is a note, not a penalty [hood.median_land_psf].
flags.phfa-infill: Because this is a vacant lot in a low-value area, it may qualify for PHFA infill or blight-related scoring, but this should be confirmed against current PHFA criteria [landuse.vacant, hood.median_land_psf].
flags.public-owner: The parcel is owned by the City, which may make it easier (though not guaranteed) to acquire through a public property-disposition process [owner.type].

nextSteps: Request a water and sewer availability letter from PWSA to resolve the unknown utility status [utilities.water_sewer].

Arrange a mine subsidence or geotechnical review given the parcel is fully within an undermined area [hazard.undermined].
Check current PHFA underwriting and infill/blight scoring criteria to see if gap financing or infill incentives apply [hood.median_land_psf, landuse.vacant].

Contact the City property-disposition process, the Zoning Administrator, and the Department of City Planning to confirm ownership transfer options and the Affordable Housing Bonus status [owner.type, overlay.iz].
